primary_title: Selective induction of interleukin-6 in mouse microglia by granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor
decision_basis: The reviews identify GM-CSF as a CNS myeloid regulator; the cited primary shows dose-dependent IL-6 production by mouse microglia after GM-CSF, with no comparable astrocyte induction.
limitations_preserved: CNS glial comparator; preserve microglia-versus-astrocyte selectivity and distinguish IL-6 protein production from IL6 gene induction, without SCI weighting or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Central inhibition of granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor is analgesic in experimental neuropathic pain
decision_basis: The reviews identify GM-CSF as an inflammatory myeloid priming factor; the cited primary shows GM-CSF potentiates LPS-induced IL-1beta release from neonatal mouse microglia.
limitations_preserved: Priming-dependent output; preserve LPS requirement, neonatal microglial model, and protein-release readout, without treating GM-CSF alone as sufficient or inferring SCI weighting.
